* Strong command of modern C++ (C++11 and later), including memory management, pointers, templates and OOP.
* Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms and their performance trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of operating system concepts: processes, threads, virtual memory, scheduling and synchronization.
* Hands-on experience developing and debugging on Linux (gcc/clang, gdb, make/CMake).
* Experience with multithreaded or concurrent programming (e.g., std: thread, OpenMP, threads).
* Strong analytical and debugging skills, and a habit of measuring before optimizing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GPU programming using CUDA or HIP/ROCm.

* Experience with parallel programming models and HPC concepts (MPI, OpenMP, SIMD/vectorization

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management**
**The Role**
AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the OpenBMC and platform management software that runs on AMD Adaptive SoC platforms. You will contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, delivering management, telemetry, and serviceability for servers, AI accelerators, and next-generation data center and embedded systems.
  
  
Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, firmware teams, and the OpenBMC open-source community, you will take new platforms from first power-on through to a supportable, upstreamable solution, and build the reference designs that AMD product teams and external customers adopt for their own platforms.
  
  
**The Person**
The ideal candidate is passionate about platform management software and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in OpenBMC and embedded Linux, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through platform bring-up and into production.
  
  
You are comfortable working across the full stack, from an I2C device to a Redfish endpoint, and have the communication skills to collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* OpenBMC Software Stack: Contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, including the phosphor services, D-Bus interfaces, and application layer that deliver manageability on AMD platforms.
* Hardware Description and Telemetry: Develop Entity Manager configurations, sensor and FRU definitions, and the thermal, power, and fan control behaviour for each platform.
* Management Interfaces: Deliver the out-of-band management surface, including Redfish and bmcweb, IPMI, remote console and KVM, and MCTP and PLDM transports.
* Firmware Update and Security: Build the update and recovery path, including image signing, A/B and golden-image recovery, root-of-trust integration, secure boot, and attestation.
* Platform and Board Bring-Up: Participate in new platform and board bring-up from first power-on, driving issues to root cause with hardware, firmware, and silicon architecture teams.
* Yocto Integration: Maintain the Yocto layers and recipes that build and configure the BMC software stack across platforms and releases.
* Upstream and Technical Leadership: Contribute to the OpenBMC project, keep AMD trees in step with upstream, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with OpenBMC or a comparable BMC software stack, including components such as Entity Manager, D-Bus services, bmcweb and Redfish, and IPMI.
* Working knowledge of BMC products and the platform management domain — server, storage, or AI accelerator board bring-up, out-of-band management, remote console and KVM, and interfaces such as I2C, eSPI, PECI, APML, MCTP, and PLDM.
* Strong embedded Linux background, including the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint: device trees, kernel configuration, driver enablement, and sysfs and hwmon.
* Working experience with the Yocto Project and OpenEmbedded — layers, recipes, and bbappends.
* Strong programming skills in C and C++, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning operating systems, drivers, firmware, and hardware, and familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Platform security and root of trust: secure and measured boot, firmware signing, and attestation.
* Experience developing reference designs, demonstration platforms, or proof-of-concept solutions adopted by product teams or external customers.
* DC-SCM, DC-MHS, OCP, or other modular hardware and open compute standards.
* Experience with AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™.
* Zephyr or another embedded RTOS, RISC-V, and inter-processor communication frameworks such as OpenAMP.
* Contributions to OpenBMC, Yocto Project, or Linux open-source projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, and demonstrated technical leadership.

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer
  
  
Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

title: AI Engineer - ASR: PraDigi, a Pratham Initiative
description:
**AI Engineer - ASR: PraDigi, a Pratham Initiative**
**About Pratham International**
Pratham International is a US 501(c)(3) established to support learning innovations for children and youth in contexts across the globe. We enable the adaptation and spread of proven and scalable education solutions pioneered in India by Pratham Education Foundation to contexts across the global south through programming and technical assistance tailored to local realities. Today, Pratham reaches approximately 7.5 million children annually across 23 Indian states and union territories and an additional 1 million across 31 countries..
  
  
Through the Pratham Shah PraDigi Innovation Centre (PraDigi), Pratham International also seeks to create technology innovations for low-resource communities, and support models aimed at learning for school, work, and life for children and youth. We work on several cutting-edge projects in the domain of Generative AI, Automatic Speech Recognition, and Natural Language Processing.
  
  
The team's innovative technology products include the Anytime Testing Model (ATM), an AI-enabled question generation and grading system that allows learners to be assessed on any topic, anytime; PadhAI: Reading Assessment App, which uses advanced speech recognition to evaluate children's reading fluency in Hindi and eight Indian languages; and a suite of LLM-powered chatbots designed for diverse learning contexts: from BaalSakhi for early childhood care, to a skilling interview bot for youth employment readiness, and OCR-based analysis tools that digitize and assess student work at scale.
  
  
At Pratham International, we build for the long term. Whether it's ensuring products are truly accessible across rural India and the global south through languages, building datasets to ensure context and accuracy for products, or gathering feedback from the field. Backed by partners like Google.org, Anthropic, and the Gates Foundation, we are committed to building digital public goods that ensure every child is in school and learning well.
  
  
**Description of the Role**
Pratham International, through its wholly-owned subsidiary in India (PULS Pvt. Ltd.), is looking to hire an AI Engineer for the PraDigi Initiative.
  
  
As an ASR Engineer, you will lead the development and deployment of speech recognition systems for automated reading assessment across multiple languages. The engineer will work across the full ASR pipeline: from supervising data collection, annotation, data preparation and model training to decoding, alignment, error analysis, and deployment. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of speech recognition, multilingual NLP, and educational assessment.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Data Collection and Annotation**

* Provide technical inputs to speech data collection design, including sampling across languages, dialects, age groups, reading levels, recording environments, devices, and target items to ensure the dataset is representative and useful for model training and evaluation.
* Define annotation guidelines and quality checks for transcripts, reading errors, disfluencies, background speech and other phenomena relevant to reading assessment.
* Work with data and field teams to identify data gaps and annotation inconsistencies through model error analysis, and recommend targeted additional data collection or re-annotation where needed.
* Help design annotation schemas and inter-annotator quality processes so labels are consistent enough for model training, alignment, and evaluation.

**Model Training**

* Train, fine-tune, and evaluate ASR models for children's read speech across multiple languages and accents.
* Build pipelines for audio preprocessing, segmentation, normalization, transcription alignment, and model training.
* Adapt existing ASR architectures such as Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, Conformer, CTC/RNN-T, or similar models for reading assessment.
* Optimize models for practical deployment environments, including low-bandwidth, store-and-forward, server-based, and potentially offline/mobile inference.

**Adopting for Reading Assessment**

* Develop approaches for accurately detecting substitutions, omissions, insertions, repetitions, partial-word attempts, hesitations and self-corrections. Implement forced alignment, phoneme-level alignment, or pronunciation-scoring approaches where required.
* Conduct systematic error analysis by language, reading level, age, accent, gender, recording conditions, and device.
* Collaborate with assessment experts and field teams to translate model outputs into measures such as reading accuracy, WCPM, fluency, and reading level.

**Benchmarking**

* Define and track ASR metrics relevant to reading assessment, including WER/CER, word-level accuracy, error-detection precision/recall, alignment accuracy, and reading-score agreement with human evaluators.
* Build reproducible experimentation and model-evaluation pipelines and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Desired Experience and Qualification**
We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer with ASR expertise that can own the ASR based reading assessment pipeline across multiple languages
  
  

* A Degree in any Mathematics/Computer Science/Data Science or related STEM field
* 3-5 years of full-time experience; at least 2 working in an AI/ML role
* Strong experience in automatic speech recognition, speech processing, or spoken-language technologies.
* Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar deep-learning frameworks.
* Experience working with modern ASR architectures and toolkits such as Hugging Face Transformers, NeMo, Kaldi, or equivalent.
* Understanding of ASR concepts including:
* acoustic modelling
* CTC / transducer / encoder-decoder architectures
* decoding and beam search
* language models
* forced alignment
* phoneme representations
* WER/CER and ASR error analysis
* Experience preparing and working with large-scale audio and transcription datasets.
* Ability to diagnose model errors systematically rather than relying only on aggregate transcription accuracy.

**Why join us?**

* **Impact at a Global Scale:**
  Your work will directly support the learning journeys of millions of children. With programs active in 31 countries, you will help build Digital Public Goods that bridge the gap for the millions of children across the Global South who still struggle with foundational literacy.
* **Unique Technical Challenges**
  : We apply advanced machine learning where it is needed most. You will solve "last-mile" problems—such as training ASR models on children's voices and optimizing LLMs for offline, low-bandwidth environments—that are rarely addressed in the commercial sector.
* **A Culture of Growth and Evidence**
  : At Pratham, we value rigorous testing and continuous learning. You will have the autonomy to experiment with the latest SOTA models, supported by a 5-year strategic roadmap and funding from partners like the Gates Foundation and Anthropic.
* **High-Calibre, Mission-Driven Team**
  : You will work alongside a global team of experts from institutions like MIT, Harvard, and INSEAD. Our alumni have gone on to lead successful startups and international policy shifts, all while remaining dedicated to the goal of "Every Child in School and Learning Well."
* **Inclusive and Collaborative Environment**
  : Join a diverse team that spans Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We value innovative thinking and local expertise, ensuring that the technology we build is deeply rooted in the realities of the communities we serve.

**Employment Details**

* **Contract Type**
  : Full-Time Employment
* **Date of Joining**
  : Immediate
* **Work from Anywhere in India**
  : We offer a flexible, remote-first work environment for candidates based anywhere in India. While you have the autonomy to work from where you are most productive, you will have the unique opportunity to travel to our field locations periodically. These visits are essential to see your models in the hands of learners and to gather the real-world feedback that drives our innovation.
* **Competitive Remuneration**
  : Salary is benchmarked against industry standards for AI roles and is commensurate with experience. As a global organization, we are committed to providing a package that recognizes the high-market value of your technical expertise alongside the deep social impact of your work.

**To apply**

* **Fill out the form attached**
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further rounds
* Please refer to this Guidance on Candidates AI Usage by Anthropic to understand how to present yourself to Pratham International effectively

**Pratham International is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
We are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, gender, disability, or any other legally protected status.
